article.title: Barca condemn PSG tifo inciting 'violence and hatred'
article.summary: Barcelona report Paris Saint-Germain to Uefa after a tifo featuring a message which they say "incites violence and hatred in sport" was displayed ahead of Tuesday's Champions League match.
